key.name: hangul-layout
key.description: A layout id from libhunmin/data/layouts (a layout whose mode is "hangul"). An id the engine cannot load degrades to the default and is reported, never silently mispaired.

key.name: latin-layout
key.description: A layout id whose mode is "latin".

key.name: commit-unit
key.description: word: deliver the whole word at the boundary, keeping the finished syllables visible as preedit until then. syllable: deliver each syllable as the engine finalises it. The delivered TEXT is identical either way, which is what makes this a preference rather than a behaviour fork.

key.name: autoswitch
key.description: The engine holds the value and the key; this is only the store. The engine refuses ON when the English word list is not installed (B3), so a store reading true does not promise the feature is active — read the engine's answer back instead of trusting this value.

key.name: switch-keys
key.description: Keysyms this engine treats as the 언어 전환 key, in IBus hotkey grammar. Setting this row also removes these keysyms from org.freedesktop.ibus.general.hotkey trigger: the daemon consumes a key that is in that list before an engine ever sees it, so a row that did not edit it would name keys it cannot receive. Entries containing Release are dropped (this engine acts on presses only) and entries containing Meta are dropped (IBus cannot parse that modifier).
